name: Helmed Horror
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The helmed horror has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Immunity
traits.text: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical immunities include fireball, heat metal, and lightning bolt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.
